title: Meta-SGD family update vector with Mirror low-rank codes
hypothesis: A shared rank-4 basis plus per-family Mirror codes compresses Meta-SGD update vectors for correlated task families while retaining one-step query quality; increasing family heterogeneity reveals when private update coordinates are required.
physical_object: Shared 32D initialization and family-conditioned update vector bank
mirror_coordinate: Per-family rank-4 code reconstructing a Meta-SGD update vector from a shared basis

task.query_metric: Mean and worst-family quadratic query loss after one support-gradient update
task.support_gradient: Family-diagonal quadratic task with sampled target and additive support-gradient noise

controls: One global Meta-SGD update vector shared across families
Independent full Meta-SGD vector per family
Mirror shared PCA rank-4 basis plus family codes
Native PCA rank-4 factorization with identical decoder
Seeded random rank-4 subspace plus fitted family coefficients
success_gate: At heterogeneity 0 and .25 on both development seeds, Mirror query loss <=1.10x independent family Meta-SGD and complete payload <=75% of independent family vectors; strict Mirror-specific gain over native PCA in at least one preregistered quality/bytes/compute metric.
failure_gate: Mirror misses quality or byte gate, or exactly aliases native PCA without strict Mirror-specific gain. Fresh seeds remain sealed.
boundaries: Synthetic diagonal quadratic task families only
Analytic least-squares meta-fit; no learned initialization claim
No language-model or broad few-shot claim
